hover.sidebarRow: Background switches to alpha 5%, 3-dot action menu appears with 120ms fade-in
hover.button: Subtle background darken (light) or lighten (dark) with 120ms transition
hover.iconButton: Square 32x32 hit target, background transitions to alpha 6%, border-radius: 8px

focus.composerFocus: Border becomes slightly more pronounced, no harsh browser outline, box-shadow maintains elevation

active.buttonScale: transform: scale(0.98) on active press with 80ms transition

selected.sidebarRow: Background switches to alpha 8% (light) / alpha 10% (dark), font-weight shifts to 510

approvalAccept: Instant optimistic state update, button shows checkmark spinner
fileRowHover: Right-aligned actions appear, subtle background shift
diffInlineScrub: Hovering over line reveals git blame and rollback icons
toolCardToggle: Smooth 180ms height transition revealing stdout/stderr logs
